description:
The Fremen sietch scenario is the recommended opening for Sands of Arrakis. Three survivors arrive with the clothing and knowledge needed for desert work, but must establish their own food, water and power before the carried stores are spent.

Choose a site with genuine rock for shelter and retreat. The first rooms and supply routes determine how safely the group can expand onto the surrounding sand.
name: Fremen sietch

campaignRhythm.body: Alternate construction and replenishment with trips for spice or trade. A new room, bed or workshop creates continuing supply and hauling work. Leave enough capacity at home to maintain the water and food loop while an expedition is away.

openingDays.body:
Choose a builder with at least Construction 4 for the early powered cooking route, and share growing, cooking, tailoring and hauling among the group. Give difficult construction to the capable builder to avoid wasting scarce materials.

Install the carried personal condenser and build a fully enclosed, roofed pantry before large garden walls. A roof without walls does not keep desert mice out of food. Develop windtraps, reclaimed food and fiber beds, passive cooling, sun-cells, power leads, a fuel-cell, powered cooking and hand tailoring.

The shared opening stores include 1,150 steel, twenty industrial components, sixty Cloth, eighty water rations, sixty survival meals and sixty Chemfuel. Wearables, medicine, spice and the condenser are separate supplies. Cloth pays for cooler pads; fuel bridges emergencies while the grid and crops develop. These reserves are finite, and adverse-opening food balance remains a known alpha issue.

premise.body: The survivors begin with sandwalking between levels ten and fifteen and Fremen survival equipment. Their opening reserves support a first settlement; they do not remove the need for irrigation, collection or trade.

summary: Three Fremen survivors establish a hidden home with desert equipment, practiced sandwalking and finite starting supplies.
